components.name: Sheet primary action
components.description: Full-width task confirmation, with the existing approval behavior kept in the application.
components.css: .ds-sheet-primary{width:100%;min-height:48px;margin-top:14px;padding:11px 16px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius,10px);background:var(--accent,#00645d);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-family:var(--font-ui,"Lounge Sans TC",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-weight:400;line-height:1.6;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1));}.ds-sheet-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#00645d);outline-offset:3px}.ds-sheet-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.98)}.ds-sheet-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-sheet-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#004d47)}}

components.name: Native form field
components.description: Label and native control used in shared task sheets.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;margin:18px 0;color:var(--ink,#23332f);font-family:var(--font-ui,"Lounge Sans TC",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-weight:400;line-height:1.6;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.ds-field input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:48px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #d0dbd3;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#23332f);font:inherit;font-size:16px;caret-color:var(--accent,#00645d);transition:background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1));}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#00645d);outline-offset:3px}

components.html: <nav class="ds-booking-tabs" aria-label="預約分類"><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">可選時段</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">我的預約</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">我的候補</button></nav>

narrative.overview:
This mobile travel tool uses Operate mode: a traveller should understand the available time, current activities and next action without decoding a dashboard. The approved direction follows the restrained white surfaces, dark teal actions and clear flight information in [Cathay Pacific's official App Store screenshots](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cathay-pacific/id305038764). It remains a hackathon prototype without official branding or a claim of affiliation.

This refresh records the implemented system in styles.css, index.html, app.js and reservation-ui.js. It includes compact flight context, a simpler timeline, native activity menus, a text-only itinerary and illustrated service rows, separate booking views and a local Traditional Chinese font. The follow-up restores the original four-point assistant mark, adds softly tinted conversation space with framed AI replies, and aligns the planner footer with the assistant toolbar. It supersedes the previous claim that the branch differs only in CSS and theme-color metadata. Reservation integration retains its recorded provenance in Ray's upstream commit 5abcd8f81884fc8f58acf7c18181bfe58368ac37; presentation changes do not redefine its API, approval or business rules.
keyCharacteristics: White reading surfaces with restrained teal actions and explicit state text.
Local Lounge Sans TC for the bundled interface, with system fallback for missing glyphs.
Compact flight context, a readable timeline and flat service rows.
Native disclosure for activity actions and inventory diagnostics.
Fixed planning actions and conversation input, with independently scrolling content.

rules.name: The State With Text Rule
rules.body: Confirmed, pending, offered and expired states retain readable labels; color never stands in for the booking state or approval requirement.

rules.name: The One Interface Typeface Rule
rules.body: Keep operational headings, forms and messages in the bundled interface family and its fallback stack; do not introduce a decorative display pairing or synthesize unprovided weights.

rules.name: The Flat Except Overlays Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary activity and service content flat; use the existing menu and selected-segment shadows only for those specific layers.

dos: **Do** keep flight context compact and give the actual itinerary the main reading space.
**Do** use the bundled interface font with its explicit fallback stack and tabular time values.
**Do** use flat service rows, clear separators and native disclosure for secondary actions.
**Do** preserve all five quick actions, native controls and keyboard focus.
**Do** keep booking state, demonstration labels and confirmation requirements explicit.
**Do** preserve existing API, approval, reservation, timing and recovery rules when changing presentation.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce decorative hero photography, fake device status chrome, section slogans or nested discovery cards.
**Don't** treat a pending proposal, queue entry or offered slot as an approved reservation.
**Don't** present SQLite demo inventory or a simulated flight as live Cathay data.
**Don't** add a display font, synthetic font weight or a claim of complete CJK coverage.
**Don't** generalize current smaller target exceptions or hidden legacy decorative symbols into component defaults.
**Don't** apply overlay shadows to every list row or plain container.
